story: Discover the stunning Penan Bulbul (*Alophoixus ruficrissus*), a member of the diverse Pycnonotidae family. Native to Lowland and montane forests; primary/well-aged secondary growth; mid-storey of rainforests, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Least Concern (LC) on the IUCN Red List, the Penan Bulbul represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
